comment: Rosepen 05-05 Live Sketch lock. Points and expected values are in fixture user units (1 uu = 1 mm) and are hand-derived from the fixture (see the INVARIANT comment in live-sketch.svg) and the pure model, never from a render. Each scenario drives app.live-sketch headless and checks the plain-SVG export (new path count, id, parent, sibling position, label, exact style, document bbox, node/C/L counts, open flag, worst point-to-curve distance) and RGB pixel samples on the PNG (and PDF when built with capypdf).

two-point._comment: Two points make one cubic (lib2geom fits len == 2 exactly): nodes 2, C 1, endpoints (10,10)/(110,10), bbox 10..110 x 10. A 2 mm stroke covers y 9..11, so (60,10) is black and (60,12.5) is page white. Default parent is the last layer L2.

raw-polyline._comment: Smoothing 0 is the exact raw trail: 21 nodes through all 21 zigzag points, 20 line segments, bbox 10..190 x 49..51.

smooth-noisy._comment: Default smoothing 50 = 2.5 mm. The line y = 50 is within 1 mm of every point, so only a few cubics are needed and every point stays within 2.5 mm. FINDING (05-05 Task 2): the plan expected 2 nodes / C 1; lib2geom's spike heuristic rejects a single cubic for this zigzag (a max_beziers=1 attempt returns -1) and splits into 2 cubics, whose true worst distance is 1.96 mm. The bound and the small node count are locked here; 3 nodes / C 2 is the re-derived expectation.

tight-smoothing._comment: Smoothing 10 = 0.5 mm, below the +-1 mm amplitude, so the fit must follow the zigzag: at least 3 nodes (at most the 21 input points) and every point within 0.5 mm.

closed-gesture._comment: A gesture that returns to its start stays OPEN: 5 nodes, 4 line segments, no Z, first node == last node, bbox 20..60 x 20..60. Fill is none, so the centre (40,40) is white while (40,20) is on the 2 mm top stroke.

into-group._comment: g1 is translate(100,50) scale(2). Document points (110,60)/(150,60) are g1-local (5,5)/(25,5); the local d keeps those and the document bbox is 110..150 x 60. A 2 mm visual stroke in a 2x group is 1 local unit, so stroke-width is 1.

styled._comment: Explicit stroke colour and 2 mm width on the line y = 80: (100,80) is blue, (100,82.5) is clear of the 2 mm band and stays white. r0 and g1 are untouched.

two-calls._comment: Two calls in one run: both append to L2 in call order, so a1 is not the last child and b1 is.

handoff-artistic._comment: app.live-sketch selects its new path; select-by-id:ls3 selects it explicitly by id, then artistic-apply converts it in place: the same id carries the artistic media effect (path-effect + original-d) and the rosepen-artistic class. No pixel samples: headless export does not re-evaluate live effects.

huge._comment: Huge but in-plane coordinates (1e6, far outside the page) behave like small ones: 3 nodes, 2 line segments, bbox 1000000..1000200 x 1000000..1000050. No pixel samples (off the page).

bad-input._comment: Every call fails before changing the document, so no path is created and the fixture is unchanged: r0 is still the grey square at (5,5)..(15,15).
stderr_contains: live-sketch: needs at least two distinct points
live-sketch: smoothing must be between 0 and 100
live-sketch: stroke-width must be > 0 and <= 100 mm
